releases.headline: Audio and subtitle menus
releases.summary: Audio and subtitle menus · Compatibility and distribution
releases.brief: One panel for audio and subtitles. Readable track names.

highlights.title: One panel for audio and subtitles
highlights.text: The desktop player, phones, tablets, iOS source builds and Android TV now open a single Audio & subtitles panel from either player button.

highlights.title: New interface strings have entries in every supported Compose and TV catalog; native-speaker review remains outstanding.
Readable track names
highlights.text: Long release titles such as "Japanese / Opus / 2.0 / 48 kHz / 192 kbps / JPBD" now appear as the language followed by a short line of stream facts: codec, channels, bitrate and edition.

releases.headline: Lists and tracking integrations
releases.summary: Lists and tracking integrations · Playback and Samsung TV reliability · Sign-in and profile PIN screens · Compatibility and distribution
releases.brief: Unified desktop Lists tab. Recover skip markers. Refreshed sign-in screens.

highlights.title: Unified desktop Lists tab
highlights.text: Manage supported statuses, ratings and watched-episode progress across connected MyAnimeList, Simkl, Trakt and MDBList accounts.

highlights.title: Recover skip markers
highlights.text: Combine chapters from the active media file with available intro, recap and credits timing sources on desktop and compatible TVs, preserving known post-credits scenes.

highlights.title: Refreshed sign-in screens
highlights.text: Update phone, desktop, Android TV, iOS source and Samsung/LG TV layouts with clearer sign-in controls and improved focus and keyboard navigation.

releases.headline: MyAnimeList and playback improvements
releases.summary: MyAnimeList and playback improvements · Improvements included since the last published release · Compatibility and distribution
releases.brief: Completed rewatch counts on desktop. More accurate desktop playback.

highlights.title: Completed rewatch counts on desktop
highlights.text: Synchronize MyAnimeList's completed-rewatch total, show it in anime details and MAL list entries, and provide an explicit Finish rewatch action and count correction.

highlights.title: More accurate desktop playback
highlights.text: Preserve resume positions until confirmed and improve intro-skip seeking.

highlights.title: Existing accounts, profiles, playback history, downloads, device pairings and local preferences are retained; no migration or backend deployment is required.

releases.headline: Profile PIN protection and avatar choices
releases.summary: Profile PIN protection and avatar choices · TV installer discovery · Compatibility and release scope
releases.brief: Profile security restored. Scan only the chosen platform.

highlights.title: Profile security restored
highlights.text: Existing signed-in profiles now show the PIN lock controls in Edit Profile.

highlights.title: Scan only the chosen platform
highlights.text: Samsung and LG scans now respect the selected television type instead of scanning both brands together.

highlights.title: Existing profiles, PINs, libraries, account sessions and custom avatar URLs are preserved; no data migration or backend deployment is required for this client update.

releases.headline: Windows installer experience
releases.summary: Windows installer experience · Compatibility and release scope
releases.brief: Clearer installation choices. Guided updates and removal.

highlights.title: Clearer installation choices
highlights.text: The Windows setup screen now keeps the destination, Start menu and desktop shortcuts, and optional Starlit TV Installer developer preview together before installation begins.

highlights.title: The redesign uses the existing Windows setup engine and command interface, without changing install locations, account data, add-ons, download logic, TV pairing or automatic update behavior.
Guided updates and removal
highlights.text: Update review shows the installed and target versions and offers a direct way to change installation options.
